residency_notes: Xiaomi MiMo says customers can request selectable data-storage regions, subject to legal and commercial requirements, and that regional accounts use different base URLs and keys. The public terms do not specify the available regions, a fixed execution location, or a named ZDR control.
prompt_training_notes: Xiaomi's MiMo Open Platform Privacy Policy says API-submitted content is collected to process the request and generate a response, and that Xiaomi will not use the content for model training or any other purposes.
